hero.title: St Andrew's Day Dinner
hero.lede: Around 30 November, Scotland's national day, we put a Scottish menu on the table, raise a dram to the saint, and keep the rooms in the hotel for anyone who would rather not drive home.

sections.title: St Andrew's Day at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
St Andrew has been Scotland’s patron saint for centuries, and 30 November, his feast day, is the country’s national day. It is a quieter celebration than Burns Night or Hogmanay, which is part of its appeal: an evening for good Scottish food, a dram and a bit of music, without the speeches.

At Bentley Hotel the night is built around the kitchen. We serve a Scottish menu for the evening, drawing on the things the country does well, cooked in our own kitchen, with the dishes and the price confirmed each season. We raise a dram to the saint and the saltire. Tables range from two to a party of friends or a club night out, and for a larger group we can set the function suite for private dining and arrange live music or a ceilidh band.

St Andrew’s Day also opens the winter here. The festive season follows close behind, and Burns Night comes round in January, so if you’re looking for a night out with colleagues or a club before the Christmas rush, this is the one. Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk for anyone coming from Glasgow or Edinburgh, parking is free, and our 18 en-suite rooms are here if you’d rather stay and have breakfast with us.

sections.title: The room, the menu and the night after

items.title: The function suite
items.text: For a group, our Back o' Barns function suite seats up to 100 for dinner and is air-conditioned, and we can arrange live music or a ceilidh band for the night. Smaller parties eat in the restaurant or the conservatory.

items.title: A Scottish menu
items.text: A menu for the night from our own kitchen, built on Scottish cooking, with a dram to go with it. The dishes and the price are confirmed each season.

items.title: Stay the night
items.text: Stay in the hotel in one of our 18 en-suite rooms and finish the celebration with a full Scottish breakfast cooked to order. Check-in is from 2pm and check-out by 11am.

sections.title: St Andrew's Day: what people ask us

items.q: How do we book for St Andrew's Day?
items.a: Phone us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry and tell us how many you expect. We’ll give you this year’s date, menu and price and keep a table for you. For a club or works night, say roughly how many are coming and whether you’d like music.

items.q: Do we need to pay a deposit?
items.a: Group bookings and private hire of the function suite usually need a deposit. We’ll set out how much, when it is due and our cancellation terms before you confirm.

items.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about allergies, intolerances and vegetarian or vegan guests when you book and the kitchen will plan a Scottish menu that works for everyone at the table.

items.q: Is there parking, and can we come by train?
items.a: Yes to both. Parking at the hotel is free, and Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk, with trains to Glasgow Central (under 20 minutes at the fastest) and to Edinburgh. Rather than travel late, book a room and stay the night.

sections.title: Celebrate St Andrew's Day with us
sections.text: Give us your numbers and we’ll hold a table, or the function suite for a group. Rooms can be booked online.
